blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The prosecution’s decision to withdraw three of the four impeachment charges against Vice President Sara Duterte was partly driven by concerns that the defense would prolong the proceedings by presenting an extensive lineup of witnesses. House Deputy Speaker and Iloilo 1st District Rep. Janette Garin said Duterte’s defense lawyers seems pursuing procedural delays that could prevent the Senate impeachment court from reaching a timely decision on the allegations. “Napakalinaw po na yung direksyon ng depensa ay to delay, delay, and divert,” Garin said.
